$comment: Reviewed status of the open GitHub Dependabot advisories. Every claim names how it can be re-checked. Raw npm audit output stays unsuppressed in CI (raw-production-audit artifact).

evidence: npm pack decode-uri-component@0.5.0/0.5.1 diff: only index.js and version change; the quadratic per-key RegExp replace loop is replaced by one input.replace(multiMatcher, decode) pass
same maintainer and repository (SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component); no new dependency or install script
npm audit --omit=dev no longer lists decode-uri-component

advisories.chain: @circle-fin/{bridge-kit,swap-kit,earn-kit,adapter-viem-v2,adapter-solana,provider-*,borrow-*} pin zod 3.25.67 exactly; @reown/appkit-wallet uses zod 3.22.4; root zod 3.25.76; @wagmi/connectors (porto) already on 4.6.7
advisories.reason: No zod 3.x release fixes the advisory (latest 3.25.76). Circle SDKs, including the newest @circle-fin/bridge-kit 1.16.1, pin zod 3.25.67 exactly; forcing zod 4 would break their runtime schemas.
advisories.mitigation: scripts/apply-zod-collection-backport.mjs patches the oversized-collection checks into all locked zod v3 copies (verified by scripts/verify-zod-collection-backport.mjs); Circle responses are size-bounded before parsing (scripts/verify-circle-response-limits.mjs). Porto keeps zod 4.6.7 via overrides.
advisories.recheck: npm view @circle-fin/bridge-kit dependencies.zod; npm view zod versions

advisories.chain: @circle-fin/* -> @ethersproject/abi@5 -> hash -> abstract-signer -> abstract-provider -> transactions -> signing-key@5.8.0 -> elliptic@6.6.1
advisories.reason: 6.6.1 is the latest published elliptic version.
advisories.reachability: Not in the production bundle: elliptic-only strings (e.g. 'Signature without r or s', 'Key does not belong to curve') are absent from dist/assets. Machina never creates or signs with keys in the browser; wallets sign.
advisories.recheck: npm run build && grep -l 'Signature without r or s' dist/assets/*.js

keptForPausedOrRetiredCode.@circle-fin/borrow-kit: used by the paused Borrow implementation (src/lib/borrow*.ts, still type-checked)
